channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: A new mental health campus is coming to historic state hospital in Norwalk
item.description: State and county officials on Friday broke ground on a new mental health care campus in Norwalk. The new facility will be located across six now-vacant buildings at the Metropolitan State Hospital.

item.title: Cal State Bakersfield basketball coach faces charges of pimping and possession of drugs and firearms
item.description: The head basketball coach and the athletic director at CSU Bakersfield are out after a probe that led to the arrest of assistant coach Kevin Mays on suspicion of pimping.

item.title: Santa Ana winds, 'big warm-up' ahead for Southern California
item.description: Another round of gusty, dry Santa Ana winds will bring more warm weather across Southern California this weekend, with widespread highs expected to reach into the 80s. Gusty winds will be a concern in some areas.

item.title: On a quiet street in Carson, seniors were neglected and malnourished, authorities say
item.description: According to the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department, a seemingly ordinary home in Carson was allegedly operating as an unlicensed senior care facility where elderly residents were malnourished and being neglected.

item.title: Honey is wrapping up her first course at San Bernardino Valley College. She's only 10 years old
item.description: A 10-year-old girl from San Bernardino is taking a college course. A school official said she could be a doctor by the age of 20.

item.title: Hundreds of applications, no jobs and AI competition: California's brutal tech work landscape
item.description: Thousands of tech workers have already lost their jobs this year and leaders at some companies say AI will enable employers to do more with smaller teams.

item.title: Jaylen Brown video sparks furor over how Beverly Hills police treat Black people
item.description: Amid its tony palm tree-lined neighborhoods and luxury shopping destinations, issues surrounding the treatment of people of color have simmered for years in Beverly Hills.

item.title: Veteran Rep. Darrell Issa decides not to seek reelection in new Democratic-leaning district
item.description: Veteran Republican Rep. Darrell Issa has decided not to run for reelection in his newly configured congressional district in San Diego and Riverside counties.

item.title: The neuro disease rat lungworm has reached California
item.description: A neurological disease spread by rats and other animals may have become established in San Diego County.

item.title: As gas prices rise, California gets punched harder at the pump than other states
item.description: Gas prices are on the rise amid U.S. conflict with Iran
